description: This is a PHP source file defining the EducationDao class within the OrangeHRM project. The class provides data access methods for the Education entity, including CRUD operations, search, pagination, and validation functionalities related to education records.

classes.name: EducationDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for Education entity, providing methods to save, retrieve, list, count, delete, and validate education records.

methods.name: saveEducation
methods.description: Persists an Education entity and returns it.

methods.name: getEducationById
methods.description: Retrieves an Education entity by its ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingEducationIds
methods.description: Fetches IDs of existing Education records from a list of provided IDs.

methods.name: getEducationByName
methods.description: Retrieves an Education entity by its name, trimmed of whitespace.

methods.name: getEducationList
methods.description: Returns a list of Education entities based on search filter parameters, using pagination.

methods.name: getEducationListPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator object configured with search filters for Education entities.

methods.name: getEducationCount
methods.description: Returns the count of Education entities matching the search filter.

methods.name: deleteEducations
methods.description: Soft deletes Education records by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingEducationName
methods.description: Checks if an Education name already exists in the database.
